page: Microsoft Azure DC32ads_v5 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCADSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture and an AMD processor. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration includes a bundled local SSD storage capacity of 1229 GB. Additionally, the instance is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing for integration with high-performance external storage options. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and substantial local SSD storage, the DC32ads_v5 offers resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads and database hosting. The combination of dedicated AMD processing cores and local solid-state storage makes it a viable option for enterprise applications, relational databases, and mid-tier web serving environments requiring consistent CPU allocation without the overhead of specialized GPU hardware.
